content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Gannett ALLY eLearning <noreply@talentlms.com>
Sent: Monday, August 12, 2019 11:57 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: ACTION REQUIRED | Gannett ALLY Training [015D] 
 
Hello Anthony Fenech,
You were recently enrolled to take the Becoming an ALLY eLearning course. To date we have not received notice of your completion of this training.

As a reminder, please set aside approximately 1 hour to complete both the course and survey by Tuesday, August 27, 2019. Your participation is a critical component to the success of this initiative and will help us to better align future Inclusion, Diversity, & Equity trainings.

Please Note: You can take the course and survey on any computer with Internet access. It is best viewed using either the Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge browser. To begin, please go to OKTA (https://gannett.okta.com) and select the chicklet with our blue ALLY icon labeled "Becoming an ALLY eLearning".

Can't complete in one sitting? Need to pause the course? No problem, the eLearning is self-paced. You can start and leave the course as often as you'd like. When you return to the course, the program will bring you back to where you left off.
Technical difficulties? Contact the Gannett Help Desk at support@gannett.com or call 855-876-4357.

Questions about the material? If you have questions about the content in the course, please visit MyLife@Work | Ask HR and click to either chat or ask a question by selecting ALLY eLearning in the category dropdown menu, and clicking Submit. A member of the People Team will contact you.
